hypotheses.H1: zero unexplained identity/projection mismatch under declared failure model
hypotheses.H2: lossless candidate saves >=20% analytical bytes and <=2x median time for EVERY required query
hypotheses.H3: RIS 1x physical replay exactness, final selected-offset lag zero, drain <=10% producer duration

policies: Reuse accepted Phase17/18/19 parser/canonicalization/counting namespaces; no identity, fingerprint, exclusion or precision changes

authorization.bounded: owner request plus reasonable-resource instruction: reversible local evaluation and lightweight pilot
authorization.heavy: NOT_AUTHORIZED: full repeated service matrix and RIS paced replay require separate explicit approval
authorization.duckdb: NOT_APPROVED; use stdlib SQLite, no new database dependency
authorization.data: cached sources only; no external rows/public ledgers, no new downloads

controls.cache: fresh worker process per configuration, then warm query repeats; OS cache NOT evicted
controls.cpu_pool: Arrow CPU2 / IO2 explicitly enforced; SQLite query1

pilot.mode: direct Parquet re-encoding of pinned accepted normalized oracle projections; parser cost excluded explicitly
inputs: first complete RIS five-minute occurrence projection
first 4096 DNS raw rows in physical order
pilot.verification: exact Arrow schema and ordered row projection equality; not new source parser validation

E2R.normalized_projection: canonical tuple UTF-8 member_encoding losslessly determines scope/asn/prefix/max_length and membership_id under frozen membership-v1; same projection and metadata across candidates
E2R.checkpoint_placement: initial day1 plus day8: checkpoint each 7 accepted consecutive days after initial baseline
E2R.shared: 13 exact added/removed transition projections, source archives once, raw source-coordinate maps once, same day descriptors

queries.all_days: reconstruct every accepted day, exact sorted tuple comparison with independent read-only SQLite oracle
queries.membership: first lexicographic canonical tuple on September1, lookup on September14
queries.daily_transitions: all13 exact additions/removals and daily counts

E2R.timing: Final query execution/output excludes independently timed verification; outer command wall includes imports/startup. Initial inclusive runs archived and excluded.
E2R.storage: analytical tuple baselines/checkpoints + all13 transition sidecars; metadata measured separately; shared source/maps/descriptors once each. No Kafka/checkpoint omission: accepted service all-in historical inventory separately, not assigned to new local-only representations

pending_cells: E3B nested modes and 0.5/1/2x uniform/burst paced service replay
stop: Any exact projection conflict/missing/extra, budget breach or sampler failure stops affected run; retain failed namespace; no automatic costly retry
